summary: Glass House Brands Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, reporting its second quarter 2026 financial results. The release highlights record biomass production, cost improvements, the completed deconsolidation of its retail business (Glass House Retail, LLC), and an uplisting to NYSE. The company reaffirmed its full-year production forecast. This is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The deconsolidation was previously announced and forms part of ongoing operations, not a new transactional event in this filing.
